mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace a Range Rover engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on your model, engine type, whether you choose a used or reconditioned unit, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration for an accurate quote based on your vehicle.

mainEntity.name: How much is it to replace a Range Rover Sport engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prices vary by Sport model year, engine variant and the type of replacement chosen. A used unit is usually cheaper than a reconditioned one. Contact us with your details for a vehicle-specific quote.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to rebuild a Range Rover engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rebuild costs depend on the extent of internal damage, parts required and labour time. An inspection is usually needed before an accurate figure can be given, as hidden damage may change the scope of work.

mainEntity.name: Is it cheaper to rebuild or replace an engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the damage. A rebuild can be cheaper when problems are limited, while a used replacement may cost less when damage is extensive. We explain both options so you can compare them clearly.

mainEntity.name: How do I know which engine fits my Range Rover?

acceptedAnswer.text: The correct engine depends on your model, year, fuel type and engine code, not just engine size. Share your registration or VIN, and we will help confirm a compatible unit before you order.

mainEntity.name: Is a used engine worth it on an older Range Rover?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the vehicle's value, overall condition and how long you plan to keep it. A used engine is often the most cost-conscious option, and we will advise honestly if it may not be worthwhile.

mainEntity.name: What details should I send with my enquiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Please send your registration number, model, year and a short description of the engine problem. Any diagnostic results, warning messages or garage reports also help us recommend a suitable replacement engine.
